climate_source.climate_value_grain: Unique original source WGS84 coordinate tuple and destination site coordinate; evaluate source climate and destination current climate as pre-response geometry, no historical occupancy assumption
climate_source.missingness: No imputation. Retain only blocks with >=2 independent source coordinates complete for 8 original climate bands and destination 0BP present; keep original roles.

matching.unit: Within the same original (study,taxon,site,fitness_type) cell, compare pairs of *distinct original source population IDs* with different original coordinates.
matching.source_pair_deduplication: Report also unique (study,taxon,unordered source_ID pair) to avoid treating the same origin pair in many gardens/outcomes as independent.
matching.source_0BP_SD: Training species-equal weighted SD of current four climate bands across unique original source coordinates, dividing each source genus sample by number of source coordinate units and species evenly.
matching.history_at_source: Four-dimensional Euclidean norm of (BIO21ka - BIO0BP) / frozen training current SD, at each original source; H-history is not a realized occupied past trajectory.
matching.modern_climate_pair_distance: Euclidean norm of differences of original source pair four BIO0BP values standardized by frozen train source SD.
matching.H_pair_absolute_difference: Absolute difference between two source historical displacement magnitudes, normalized by training species-equal SD of source H magnitudes.
matching.source_only_modern_matched_threshold: Modern standardized 4-dimensional climate distance <=1.0; source-only geographical design rule, not tuned on fitness.
matching.source_only_H_contrasted_threshold: Absolute standardized history-magnitude difference >=0.5; source-only qualification not an adaptation effect.
matching.within_garden_source_history_linear_cond: Regress source H on current source 4 climate bands, source latitude, longitude and source-garden great-circle distance, after absorbing study×taxon×site×fitness_type cell means. Compute weighted residual H variability; no response opened.
matching.source_equal_weighting: Each training species equal total weight, each qualifying garden cell equal subweight, each distinct original source coordinate in cell equal subweight.
